The industry is still leaning on a ten-year-old hardware blueprint that has reached its limit. A new paradigm that is faster and more efficient will be the biggest economic opportunity of the next century and create the most important company of the next decade. The OLIX Decode Accelerator 1 (DX-1) is the first accelerator architected specifically for decode. Rack-scale co-design of logic, data movement, packaging, optics and interconnect enables a step change in system level performance. The Role As a Staff Embedded Software Engineer, you will be the design authority for a major area of the DX-1 platform firmware, within the overall platform architecture. You will report to the Platform Architect who leads the Embedded team and work closely with the FPGA, ASIC and Systems Software teams. You bring exceptional depth on both sides of the hardware-software boundary, the judgment to identify what matters most and why, and the ability to influence and align engineering teams without relying on formal authority. It is a hands-on individual-contributor role. We will judge it by what others can build on: specs other teams work to, firmware that is ready when the hardware is, and designs that still hold up a year on. jobs.title: Case Resolution Engineer
jobs.description: Our team is committed to enhancing physician and patient quality of life through Elation, a SaaS cloud-based clinical platform. Since inception, we've been focused on building a delightful, world-class experience that empowers physicians to deliver phenomenal care to patients. Customer support has been the same job for twenty years: a queue, a ticket, an SLA, a closed case. That's ending, fast. Over the next 6–9 months, AI will take on more of the routine, repetitive cases at Elation. That doesn't shrink the human role — it builds on it. The work becomes product intelligence: shaping how AI handles conversations, holding the customer-trust moments that need real judgment, and turning patterns into priorities Engineering delivers. We're hiring Support Engineers to anchor that shift: people who don't just close tickets, but trace them back to the line of product code causing them, ship the fix that resolves the customer's problem immediately, and partner with senior engineers on the cases complex enough to need them. You might be the recent engineering grad who spent a summer at a busy front desk, in a popular restaurant, or on a support line because you like people as much as you like problems, and who's been quietly automating things nobody asked you to fix since your first CS class. Or, you might be the person who leads team projects, tinkers with the dashboards, automations, or workflows so automatically that colleagues assume you are an engineer even if you aren’t. If that sounds like you, this role turns that problem-solving instinct into your core responsibility. As a Support Engineer, you'll bring empathy and judgment to the cases that need it most, own the quality of AI-driven solutions in your domain, and synthesize patterns that influence Product and Engineering roadmaps. jobs.title: Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01
jobs.description: Please note: For this role proficiency in both Dutch and English is required. Reliability & Maintenance Engineer | DSL-01 As Reliability & Maintenance Engineer DSL-01, you are responsible for building and continuously improving the facility's maintenance, reliability, and asset integrity framework. Reporting to the Engineering Manager, you help ensure the plant operates safely, reliably, and efficiently. The role starts with a strong Maintenance Engineering focus. Your priority will be to help establish the maintenance and reliability foundation of DSL-01 by answering a fundamental question: "how do we maintain our assets safely, reliably, and efficiently throughout their lifecycle?" You will translate reliability studies, equipment criticality assessments, and integrity requirements into practical maintenance plans, inspection programmes, spare parts strategies, and asset management processes. As the facility moves into stable operations, the focus gradually shifts towards Reliability Engineering, where you will use asset health monitoring, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement to prevent failures and improve long-term asset performance. Working closely with operations, maintenance, engineering, and external specialists, you will help reduce technical risk and improve asset reliability from day one. You will: Develop and continuously improve maintenance, inspection, and asset integrity strategies Translate reliability studies, FMECA analyses, and engineering data into practical maintenance plans within the CMMS/EAM system Act as owner of the asset register from a maintenance, reliability, and integrity perspective Support the implementation and continuous development of the facility's CMMS/EAM system Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions Monitor and improve reliability performance indicators such as MTBF

jobs.title: OT Engineer | DSL-01
jobs.description: OT Engineer | DSL-01 Werk mee aan een van de eerste grootschalige SAF-fabrieken in Europa. Je draagt bij aan de bouw van DSL-01 in Delfzijl: een fabriek gericht op de productie van Sustainable Aviation Fuel en bijproducten. Je wordt onderdeel van een ervaren team waarin jouw expertise direct bijdraagt aan een veilige en succesvolle realisatie van het project. Over de functie Als OT Engineer speel je een sleutelrol in het ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren van de Operational Technology (OT) omgeving van DSL-01. Je rapporteert aan de IT & OT Manager en werkt nauw samen met automation engineers, plant operations, maintenance, contractors, leveranciers en IT-specialisten. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat de systemen die de fabriek aansturen veilig, beschikbaar en betrouwbaar functioneren. Deze functie verbindt twee fases van het project. Tijdens de bouw van DSL-01 help je bij het maken van belangrijke ontwerpkeuzes voor de OT-omgeving. Na ingebruikname ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ondersteunen, beheren en continu verbeteren van de operationele technologie binnen de fabriek. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
jobs.description: Taktile empowers financial institutions to transform into truly AI-native organizations. We’re growing rapidly with enterprise customers across banks and insurance companies, and we’re looking for a Senior Product Manager in our Berlin or London offices. About the Role Taktile is building the world's leading Agentic Decisioning Platform for Financial Services. Our customers use our product to automate millions of critical decisions with AI across customer onboarding, credit underwriting, anti money laundering, and many other use cases. Underneath every one of these decisions sits the Taktile Platform: the permissions, environments, deployment, extensibility and connectivity foundations that allow the largest financial institutions to run Taktile securely and at scale, for both humans and AI agents. Taktile Platform also owns developer productivity: the tooling, infrastructure and workflows that help our engineering teams ship quickly and safely. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the strategy and roadmap for the platform, with a focus on its enterprise and agentic foundations. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure and security engineering to meet the demands of a rapidly growing enterprise customer base, and partner with customer-facing teams and Product Marketing to make our platform a reason customers choose Taktile. What You’ll Do Own the strategy and long-term success of the Taktile Platform, the foundation that every product area and every enterprise customer builds on Define a compelling long-term vision for the platform and prioritize the roadmap necessary to reach it. One person, one GPU. If you'd like to build the world's best AI cloud, join us. Review construction test results and witness factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, functional testing, and integrated systems testing. Develop and review energization plans, MOPs, SOPs, EOPs, switching procedures, and electrical safety controls. Support initial energization and troubleshoot issues involving substations, transformers, switchgear, UPS systems, generators, busway, PDUs, RPPs, and rack-level distribution. Validate as-built documentation, equipment settings, test reports, commissioning records, and turnover packages before operational handoff. jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
jobs.description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems. The World Map team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and handheld devices, aerial imagery, LiDAR, and 360 cameras, as well as external geographic and elevation data. Overview CircuitHub is primarily built using a combination of Haskell, Nix, and PostgreSQL, deployed to both AWS and bare metal machines. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders. This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it. About us AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one. We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team. The role You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you. On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC. Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditions, what came out, and what failed. Failed expressions and poor yields are kept as data, so they get the same care as the successes. As protocols settle you will help move them from the bench onto liquid handlers and our automated platform, working with the engineers who build it. jobs.description: Einleitung Wir sind auf der Suche nach neuen Kollegen! Migrando ist ein Legal-Tech-Unternehmen aus Cottbus. Wir haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, den komplizierten und langwierigen Prozess der Einbürgerung effizienter und kundenfreundlicher zu gestalten. Mit unserer Expertise im Ausländerrecht, unserer juristischen Kompetenz und einem starken Team von zahlreichen Mitarbeitern begleiten wir tausende Mandanten erfolgreich auf dem Weg zur deutschen Staatsbürgerschaft. Am besten verschaffst du dir gleich einen Einblick unter migrando(.)de/karriere, unserer Karriere-Page. Denn wir können hier schreiben was wir wollen, im Endeffekt bleibt es eine langweilige Einleitung. Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich? Wer jahrelang in der Praxis gearbeitet und Hands-on-Erfahrungen gesammelt hat, bringt mehr mit als jeder Kursabschluss. Bei uns zählt vor allem, was du in der Praxis wirklich draufhast — deine mehrjährige, einschlägige Erfahrung. Formale Abschlüsse und Zertifikate sind zweitrangig, wenn dein Können überzeugt. Wir bieten Dir Bei uns trägst du echte Verantwortung für die technische Grundlage, auf der alles aufbaut. Kein isoliertes Ticktabarbeiten – du gestaltest von Anfang an aktiv mit, wie unsere Systeme funktionieren und kommunizieren. Freie Toolwahl Docker Desktop, Supabase, N8N, Hubspot-API, WordPress – du arbeitest mit dem Stack, der den Job erledigt. Und wenn du ein besseres Tool kennst, wollen wir davon hören. High-End Hardware nach Wahl Egal ob MacBook Pro oder Windows-Tower. Du bekommst die Maschine, auf der du am besten performst, inkl. 4K-Monitoren. Echter Einfluss auf die Architektur Du entscheidest mit, welche Technologien wir einsetzen, wie Schnittstellen aufgebaut sind und wie unser technisches Ökosystem langfristig aussieht. Kleine Teams statt Großraumbüro Du arbeitest in überschaubaren Teams, in denen man sich kennt und schnell ins Gespräch kommt. Musik bei der Arbeit Bei uns wird

jobs.title: OT Network Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description: Über uns ju:niz Energy entwickelt, baut und betreibt netzdienliche Batteriegroßspeicher in ganz Deutschland. Unsere Anlagen stabilisieren das Stromnetz, schaffen Flexibilität und ermöglichen den weiteren Ausbau erneuerbarer Energien. Wir investieren in unsere Batteriespeicherprojekte und behalten diese langfristig im eigenen Bestand. Als OT Network Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass die Netzwerke und Infrastruktur unserer Batteriespeicheranlagen zuverlässig und sicher funktionieren. Gemeinsam mit unserem OT-Team betreibst du die technische Infrastruktur, sicherst die Kommunikation zwischen den Systemen und unterstützt die Anbindung neuer Anlagen. Deine Aufgaben Du betreibst und wartest unsere OT-nahen Infrastrukturkomponenten – von Netzwerken und Servern bis zu Endgeräten und Backup-Systemen. Beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer OT-Netzwerke gestaltest du die Architektur, setzt Netzwerksegmentierung und DMZ-Konzepte um und sorgst für sichere Schnittstellen zwischen IT und OT. Firewalls und Remote-Access-Lösungen administrierst du so, dass Fernzugriffe kontrolliert erfolgen und die Sicherheitsgrenzen unserer Systeme eingehalten werden. Die sichere Anbindung von Edge- und IoT-Komponenten sowie das Endpoint Management im OT-Umfeld liegen ebenfalls in deinem Aufgabenbereich. Gemeinsam mit unserem Cyber-Security-Team setzt du technische Standards, Systemhärtungen und ein abgestimmtes Patch-Management um. Bei Störungen in Netzwerk, SCADA oder Energiemanagementsystemen analysierst du die Ursachen und koordinierst die Behebung in enger Abstimmung mit dem Digital OT Lead und dem OT-Team. Neue Standorte und Anlagen begleitest du beim Infrastruktur-Rollout und unterstützt ihre Einbindung in unsere bestehende OT-Landschaft. Durch eine nachvollziehbare Dokumentation und einheitliche Konfigurationen schaffst du die Grundlage für einen verlässlichen Betrieb und die weitere Standardisierung unserer Infrastruktur. Mit unseren Managed-Services-Partnern und dem Cyber-Security-Tea

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Secure Container Images
jobs.description: With more than 10 billion pulls , Canonical 's container images are trusted by developers worldwide to build and run software securely and at scale. That trust rests on our commitment to hardened, production-ready images. We are advancing the state of the art with a new generation of Ubuntu-based container images we call "rocks": minimal images engineered for performance and usability and backed by long-term security commitments. As a member of the team, you will own the path from upstream source to published image, turning open source software into tested, signed, and continuously maintained artifacts that developers can deploy with confidence. This is fast-paced, multi-disciplinary software engineering. Because most of the software we package originates from third-party upstreams, you will work across a broad range of container technologies and hundreds of open source projects, often in several programming languages, integrating and maintaining them so they are easy to consume on Ubuntu. jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.description: We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want. You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models. Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week. How it works Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another. Requirements 2+ years of professional software engineering Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code) Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++ Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing Regular use of an AI coding tool Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words At least 10 hours a week, starting now A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines) Nice to have Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure Experience building agent
